input.message:
Dear Ms Marr, an update on your kitchen cabinet report (42 Brackenveil Row).

The contractor who attended to quote considers the peeling laminate cannot be repaired panel by panel, so the landlord has asked us to obtain replacement estimates. One estimate has arrived and is with the landlord; a second is still outstanding from the contractor. No work can start until the landlord approves an amount, so I cannot yet give you a date.

In the meantime, please take care around the damaged edges: keep the affected doors and panels out of use where you can, cover any exposed sharp laminate edge with strong tape as a temporary measure, and keep the dogs away from the loose sections. If anyone is cut again, please tell us straight away so it is on the record.

The dates you offered (16, 17 and 18 September) have now passed with no visit booked — I am sorry for that. Could you send three fresh windows that suit you, with the usual note about securing the dogs, so a visit can be fixed as soon as the contractor confirms? I will not book anything without your agreement.
